d: The Warriors defeated the Kings, 129-110 tonight in Golden State. De'Anthony Melton contributed a team-high 24 points to go with 8 three pointers 7 assists and 4 rebounds, with Gui Santos of the Warriors adding an additional 22 points (8-11 FG, 2-4 3P) in the game. Domantas Sabonis finished with a team-high 27 points along with 10 rebounds for the Kings in the losing effort. The Warriors improve their record to 10-8 with the win, while the Kings fall to 2-16 for the season.
